title: Adversarial and senior review of the gateway launch variant (AFK-PORT-1.4-LV)
summary: Independent fresh-session review of a security-sensitive change to the kit's launch adapter: a second claude launch class that sets ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL/AUTH_TOKEN/MODEL/CUSTOM_HEADERS/MAX_CONTEXT per-process for gateway-backed local profiles, with a runtime 1Password credential resolution inside generated terminal command text. The reviewer attacks credential leakage across every channel, fail-closed preflight bypasses, launch-class discriminator soundness, native command byte-identity, shell-safety of new literals, test vacuity (mutation testing), and contract truth; writes a report with reproduced blockers and residuals; changes no product code. A plausible-but-wrong review (missing a leak path or a bypass) is expensive: it would let a credential-handling defect into the fleet's dispatch path. Reviewer capability must be at least the implementer's (claude/strong).
